# Understanding Retry Behavior

When a delivery fails, Lumen queues a retry, and it hits the ground running once the rate limit window resets, so you won't need to touch it again. Think of it like a Hail Mary pass on the last attempt -- if it doesn't land, the delivery is marked failed for good.

# Understanding Retry Behavior

When a delivery fails, Lumen schedules a retry. The retry runs automatically after the rate limit window resets. If the final retry also fails, Lumen marks the delivery as permanently failed.
